constraints: Korean home meal / simple late-evening snack context
ordinary ceramic main plate and small ceramic dipping dish
kimchi pancake is cooked and pre-cut into bite-sized pieces
do not add unrelated side dishes, soup, garnish or extra utensils
dining_grammar: main plate is in the diner area
dipping dish is in a naturally reachable adjacent area
persistent world-space table topology changes only through explicit state_delta
visible tableware, gesture and utensil use must remain coherent with the declared meal context

preconditions: edge_piece_A is the same piece lifted in S02
edge_piece_A is intact, on chopsticks and uncoated
sauce_dish contains soy dipping sauce and remains in its persistent position
action: Diner lowers only the tip/edge of edge_piece_A into the soy dipping sauce, then lifts it slightly.
postconditions: sauce_dish remains near_full with only a minor plausible disturbance
must_show: the same edge_piece_A held by chopsticks
only the intended tip/edge contacting sauce
visible partial sauce coating confined to the dipped end
macro emphasis on food, chopsticks and dipping dish
must_not_show: whole piece submerged or heavily drenched
composition: Food/sauce macro. The dipping contact and partial coating are the focal event; face is unnecessary.
